g.text: Translated code speed: integer byte loops went from 2-7x native to native at A12; SIMD q copies stay 35x

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Slope ratio = ns per unit of work in the fragment / native. The register budget counter (A12) removed the per-instruction cost; A13 and A14 left it unchanged (calls 1.5x, copy16 1.5x).

g.text: 2026-10-11/0354-a14-code-speed.csv. Journal: 2026-10-10 09:05 and 11:51, 2026-10-11 00:37 and 03:54. Each dot = one boot (median ns per outer iteration at each n, fitted linearly against n; 7

g.text: reps per n); bar = median over boots. simd32 ratios move with its tiny native slope (0.014 ns). Platform: M1/HVF guest (4 vCPUs) on a shared, noisy host; ratios and spreads, not absolute hardware
